metadata.description: A marketplace for custom plugins and skills

plugins.name: progress-tracking
plugins.description: Continuous tracking for large work items and agent teams, with sourced events, durable state, progress and no-progress reports, worker nudges, recovery, and Markdown, Mermaid, and accessible HTML views.

plugins.name: ado
plugins.description: Azure DevOps integration for work item management, PR publishing, iterative PR tending, autonomous work item implementation, and autonomous backlog processing. Orchestrates development methodology skills via the development plugin.

plugins.name: gh
plugins.description: GitHub integration for issue and project management, PR publishing, iterative PR tending, issue-driven implementation, and autonomous backlog processing. Orchestrates development methodology skills via the development plugin.

plugins.name: development
plugins.description: Development methodology toolkit with Agile team delivery for large, long-horizon features. The agile-development skill coordinates thin end-to-end slices, durable progress state, early and continuous manual testing, observed-defect regression tests, behavioral tests for material acceptance contracts, final coverage review, verification, and final review. Includes Architect, Manual Tester, Developer, Critic, and blind-spot agents; design-first brainstorming; autonomous design; scenario-driven development as the default testing flow (manual testing from the first runnable slice, defect regressions, behavioral contract tests, then coverage-guided tests after all scenarios pass), with TDD as an explicit opt-in; subagent-driven execution; course-correction when fixes stack; compound-learning lessons read back at plan time; hooks that block git bypasses and untested completion; completion verification; code-review triage; work-item drafting; and provider-agnostic work-on and implement workflows.

plugins.name: developer-performance-review
plugins.description: Developer performance review skill for analyzing work over time (weeks/months)

plugins.name: code-reviewer
plugins.description: Code review toolkit with a general Code Reviewer agent for independent feature and merge-readiness review, built as a funnel: a cheap eligibility gate, deterministic review tiering, a shared context pack, a correctness lane and repo-history lane alongside specialized agents for duplicate detection, EUII leak scanning, exception handling, test coverage, design and code simplification, over-engineering and scope creep, architecture, performance, schema and wire compatibility, and feature-flag rollout. Findings are mechanically anchored to the diff, adversarially verified before posting, then synthesized into root causes, graded for severity and merge-blocking lane, and sequenced into an ordered fix plan, with each agent declaring the model-intelligence tier its work actually needs. Includes provider-aware review automation, structured comment publishing, and batch PR review orchestration.

plugins.name: orleans-dev
plugins.description: Microsoft Orleans patterns, best practices, and code review for virtual actor model applications — covers grain design, concurrency, cross-grain communication, streams, and serialization.

plugins.name: clean-builds
plugins.description: Achieve zero-warning builds through systematic warning elimination, code formatting, and package version validation

plugins.name: debugging
plugins.description: Log-first debugging methodology using structured JSONL logs queried with DuckDB. Includes debugging workflows, logging enablement for codebases, logging compliance review with calibrated Trace-coverage recommendations for AI-assisted debugging, and systematic root-cause debugging.

plugins.name: hitl
plugins.description: Install and configure HITL, connect Inbox or the tray client, and guide cross-device questions, plan reviews, notifications, and durable progress through automatic usage hooks.
